name: Eternal Dynasty
background:
The Eternal Dynasty are a faction of advanced aliens from the Kusari sector. Their forces consist of well armed infantry and drones, supported by high tech robots and vehicles.

Originally, they emerged from a world long divided into a patchwork society of warring clans. The royal house became adept at manipulating clans, leading potential rivals into a series of destructive wars before imposing their laws over survivors and forming a ruling Dynasty. The Eternal Dynasty will go to any length to maintain this fragile unity as they expand out into the stars.
backgroundFull:
The Eternal Dynasty come from the Kusari Sector, where they lived peacefully for millennia, and their home system became known as “stars of calm”, due to the enduring peace that the faction enjoyed. However, as the population continued to grow and spread through their system, a number of different philosophies began to flourish and diverge with each other. In order to maintain peace, a ruling system was established where regions were divided into clans under the nominal control of a Royal Dynasty. The Royal Dynasty was intended to serve as a mediator, and the title was intended to circulate amongst the ruling families of the various clans.

The dynastic system preserved peace for a time, but gradually the authority of the ruling dynasty began to wane as the clans continued to push for their own individual interests. Eventually, the Royal Dynasty were no longer able to mediate conflicts between clans, and conflict erupted. Over time, the Dynasty became a mere puppet of the most powerful clan, while rivalry between clans gave way to open hatred and xenophobia.

The Clan War era continued for over a century, as the clans struggled to maintain their rule over the system, until they were replaced by the next clan. Eventually, the title of Royal Dynasty fell to a family who held no specific clan allegiance. This family ceased intervening in conflicts but instead used their position to fuel conflict between the clans. 

This resulted in a series of violent and extremely bloody conflicts, which devastated the Stars of Calms and greatly weakened the clans. Then, the Royal Dynasty intervened and united the remaining clans under an expanded royal army. The Dynasty refused to pass on their power as tradition required, instead declaring themselves the Eternal Dynasty.  

The Eternal Dynasty’s rule has led to an age of peace and prosperity, which has allowed them to expand into the stars and beyond the Kusari sector. Yet, bitterness remains between the clans even after centuries of peace. Much of their society still bears the scars of the clan wars, and many follow the rule of the Dynasty only reluctantly, due to their role in the final conflicts that ended the Clan War Era.

How will you bring your unity to the stars?

product.description: Known as to many as the Laughing Sage, Hwan Myan Kyixi has abandoned his position with the Royal Dynasty in order to embrace self-cultivation. Possessing potent psychic abilities, Sage Myan claims that his actions are guided by the spirits which populate every corner of the universe, which he strives to live in harmony alongside. Rarely seen without his trusty drone and a heavy jug of millet wine, his joy and kind nature has helped ease over many conflict and resentments simmering between Clans and given hope to those still struggling.

Though not born of the Royal Hwan Clan, Syang Xao Fwalin bears the Dynasty’s Royal banner into battle just as her grandmother did. Such an honour has not been granted lightly; Syang Xao Fwalin rose through the ranks of the Royal Army through skill, determination, and fanatical loyalty. She has, like her grandmother, embraced the Dynasty’s promise of lasting peace and prosperity for her people.

Captain Lyao was once a rising star of the Eternal Dynasty, a brilliant tactician and skilled warrior who led armies to victory, earning nicknames like the Hero of the Shattered Belt. However, he lost the Royal Clan’s favour during the Kye-Hyoun campaign, when he forced a truce with the Dwarf Guilds in order to spare civilian lives.

As punishment, he was disgraced and sent to Loung We, a remote, barren planet close to the Radiance Exclusion Zone, to serve his remaining days in obscurity.

product.description:
As indicated by her full name, young Sergeant Hwan Wou Nyepeng hails from the ruling Royal Clan, the Hwan. She has excelled in her training and was assigned leadership of a Ninja unit. She has not been on Loung We for very long and is starting to realize that this posting might not be the ideal stepping stone for her military career.

She is an excellent fighter with a taste for acrobatic, flashy moves and perfect mastery of her Hwan Spear. As a Ninja and member of the Royal Clan, she is also tasked with gathering intelligence and reporting it to the Royal Clan.

Tragedy saw Faing Syan Hoyi separated from her family as a child when the Alien Hives raided her newly settled world. She fled into hiding along with her Cyber Tiger pet, Xaotyan, and a handful of other Cyber-Creatures. These machines often serve as pets and occasionally hunting companions for Kusarians, possessing only enough Starjade for rudimentary intelligence. She remained in hiding for years, learning to forage for food and parts alongside her robotic companions, extensively modifying them during their time together.

WuKaon05 is descended from the original ONI prototype created by the Yin upon their discovery of Starjade, making him one of the oldest known ONI still in operation. WuKaon narrowly escaped the overthrow of his Clan from their Dynastic position in what would later come to be regarded as the beginning of the Warring Clan Period.

specialRules.name: Clan Warrior
specialRules.description: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn’t apply to newly generated attacks.

specialRules.name: Imprecise
specialRules.description: Gets -1 to hit when attacking.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Stealth Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Stealth. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Teleport
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions.

specialRules.name: Ambush Beacon
specialRules.description: Friendly units using Ambush may ignore distance restrictions from enemies if they are deployed within 6" of this model.

specialRules.name: Unique Hero
specialRules.description: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Precision Fighter Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to hit rolls in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Counter in Melee Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Counter in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Rapid Advance
specialRules.description: This model moves +4" when using Advance actions.

specialRules.name: Rapid Advance Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Rapid Advance. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Fearless Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Fearless. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Bounding
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

specialRules.name: Enhanced Clan Warrior Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Clan Warrior. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Increased Shooting Range Mark
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +6" range when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Clan Warrior
specialRules.description: If this model has Clan Warrior, it gets extra attacks on successful unmodified hit results of 5-6 from Clan Warrior (instead of only on 6).

specialRules.name: Versatile Expert
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) when attacking, or get +1 to hit rolls when attacking.

specialRules.name: Ignores Cover Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ignores Cover when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Ignores Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Precision Fighter
specialRules.description: This model gets +1 to hit rolls in melee.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Piercing Marksman Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Piercing Marksman. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Rapid Charge Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game moves +4" when using Charge actions. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Vengeance
specialRules.description: When this unit is fully destroyed, place as many Vengeance markers on the unit that destroyed it as models with this rule in this unit at the beginning of the game. Friendly units get +X to hit rolls with their weapons when attacking that unit, where X is the number of markers on it. The markers are removed once the next wave of reinforcements is deployed.

specialRules.name: Casting Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 12" with Caster, which gets +1 to casting rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Destructive
specialRules.description: When attacking units with more than half of their total size or Tough value (for single-model units), those hits get AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Predator
specialRules.description: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn’t apply to newly generated attacks.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Predator
specialRules.description: If this model has Predator, it gets extra attacks on successful unmodified hit results of 5-6 from Predator (instead of only on 6).

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: Only deploys D3 rounds afters its wave, and at the start of the round it's placed within 6” of a random AI Goal.

specialRules.name: Stealth
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Hero
specialRules.description: AI units within 6” use the Villain’s Qua for Morale Tests if it’s better than their own, as long as the Villain isn’t Shaken.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Counter
specialRules.description: May strike first with this weapon when charged, unless this unit is Fatigued.

specialRules.name: Fear
specialRules.description: This model counts as having dealt +X wounds when checking who won melee.

specialRules.name: Fearless
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a Morale Test, roll one die. On a 4+ it counts as passed instead.

specialRules.name: Piercing Marksman
specialRules.description: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model's weapons get AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Caster
specialRules.description: Follows same rules as heroes, picking one random spell to cast, and spending all tokens to cast it when activated. If the chosen spell can’t be cast for any reason, then the model doesn’t cast.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

specialRules.name: Flying
specialRules.description: May move through units and terrain, and ignores the effects of terrain it doesn't end its move it. This unit automatically passes jumping rolls.
